programme.title: Fox

programme.title: A Piece of Cake

programme.title: Richard the Lionheart

programme.title: The Price of Silence
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Director: Montgomery Tully. Stars Gordon Jackson, June Thorburn & Mary Clare. Roger forges a new life for himself after his release from prison. But his past catches up with him.

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Black Brothers. 1959. Stars Conrad Phillips, Roger Delgado & Warren Mitchell. Three Italian bandits steal arms intended for the Swiss resistance and then attempt to sell them to William Tell.

programme.title: The English Riviera
programme.desc: 1958. Produced and directed by Harold Baim. A magnificent short film touring the beauty spots, historical buildings and resorts within the county of Devon, also known as the English Riviera.

programme.title: Brad Pitt: More Than a Pretty Face
programme.desc: 2022. Director: Adrien Denouette, Thibaut Seve. Dive into the brain of a complex, brilliant and endearing personality, far from the cliche of a world famous movie icon.

programme.title: Last Holiday
programme.desc: 1950. Drama. Directed by Henry Cass. Stars Alec Guinness, Beatrice Campbell & Kay Walsh. A salesman who learns he has months to live cashes in his savings to live in a fancy hotel.

programme.title: Doctor In Distress
programme.desc: 1963. Comedy. Directed by Ralph Thomas. Stars Dirk Bogarde, James Robertson Justice & Samantha Eggar. Dr. Simon Sparrow's love life improves when the lovely Delia Mallory is brought into casualty.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: 1964. English rock and pop band The Hollies perform the wonderful hit Little Lover.

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Yukon Affair. 1965. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & George Sanders. G. Emory Partridge returns with a plot to disrupt world communications. Solo and Illya travel to Alaska to stop him.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Director: Roy Ward Baker. Stars: Robert Ryan, Rhonda Fleming & William Lundigan. A tough business man is left to die with broken leg in the desert by his scheming wife and her lover.

programme.title: Maxwell
programme.desc: 2007. Drama. Director: Colin Barr. Stars David Suchet, Patricia Hodge & Ben Caplan. The final two months of the life of media tycoon Robert Maxwell, as his life is on the brink of collapse.

programme.title: The Lolo Ferrari Story
programme.desc: 2000. An insightful documentary about the life, career and tragic death of French entertainer and dancer Lolo Ferrari, a cultural icon who became the subject of heavy media exploitation.

programme.title: The Silent Partner
programme.desc: 1978. Thriller. Director: Daryl Duke. Stars: Elliott Gould, Susannah York, Christopher Plummer, John Candy. A bank teller skims $50,000 during a robbery, but the crook wants it back.

programme.title: The Wild Ride
programme.desc: 1960. Director: Harvey Berman. Stars Jack Nicholson, Georgianna Carter & Robert Bean. A rebellious punk spends his days partying and troublemaking until life catches up with him.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: John Ford is known for his visually powerful westerns with his characters framed against America's stunning natural landmarks. His four Academy Awards for Best Director remain a record.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Zelda the Great. 1966. Stars Adam West, Barbara Heller & Anne Baxter. Batman and Robin match wits and escape techniques with Zelda the Great and her fiendish master.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: A Death Worse Than Fate. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Anne Baxter. Zelda is forced to lure Batman and Robin into a possibly unsolvable deathtrap, with hitmen waiting outside if they escape.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Case of the Careless Suffragette. 1954. Starring: Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Archie Duncan. A member of parliament is killed after a suffragette has her croquet ball bomb stolen.

programme.title: Piccadilly Third Stop
programme.desc: 1960. Drama. Directed by Wolf Rilla. Stars Terence Morgan, Yoko Tani & John Crawford. A young playboy petty thief looking for the big time meets a New Yorker in London who is a bad tempered crook.

programme.title: Gaolbreak
programme.desc: 1962. Directed by Francis Searle and starring Peter Reynolds, Avice Landon and David Kernan. A mother and her two sons run a newsagents as a front for their criminal activity.

programme.title: Indiscretion of an American Wife
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Directed by Vittorio De Sica. Stars Jennifer Jones, Montgomery Clift & Richard Beymer. A married woman gets into an affair in Rome and is torn between her old life and new romance.

programme.title: Faces in the Dark
programme.desc: 1960. Drama. Directed by David Eady. Starring John Gregson, Mai Zetterling & John Ireland. Richard, a factory owner, becomes blind during an experiment on the very day his wife wants a divorce.

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: Special Branch. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, Martin Benson & Richard Bebb. A team of assassins plan to kill an American atomic scientist on his arrival in London.

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Flip and Jenny. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Jane Asher & Robert Hardy. Dan finds two children stowed away on his ship. Their father, an indentured servant, was sent to jail after refusing to work.

programme.title: The Child and the Killer
programme.desc: 1959. Crime. Director: Max Varnel. Stars Patricia Driscoll, Robert Arden & Richard Williams. A US army officer goes on the run after committing murder and orders a young boy to help him to safety.

programme.title: Look At Life Men In The Mode
programme.desc: 1961. A look into the story of the male fashion world and how it is slowly moving toward gaiety and decoration.

programme.title: A Nice Little Bank That Should Be Robbed
programme.desc: 1958. Comedy. Director: Henry Levin. Stars Tom Ewell & Mickey Rooney. Two crooks rob a bank to buy a racehorse but realise they have to continue robbing banks to support it.

programme.title: Melody
programme.desc: 1971. Comedy. Directed by Waris Hussein. Stars Mark Lester, Tracy Hyde & Jack Wild. Two youngsters declare to their parents they want to get married as soon as possible.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Stour River/Onions. 1986. While it's raining outside his shed, Jack demonstrates his mother's Yorkshire recipe using kidney onions. He then takes a trip along the river Stour.

programme.title: Dick Turpin
programme.desc: The Blacksmith. 1979. Stars Richard O'Sullivan, Christopher Benjamin & David Daker. Morgan has been captured by Spiker and an attempt at rescue only results in freeing a scoundrel.

programme.title: Van der Valk
programme.desc: A Rose of Mr Reinhart. Stars Barry Foster, Michael Latimer & Susan Travers. Arlette's intuition proves truer than her husband's after a young woman is threatened in the park.

programme.title: Night of the Demon
programme.desc: (AKA Curse of the Demon) 1957. Horror. Director: Jacques Tourneur. Stars Dana Andrews, Peggy Cummins & Niall MacGinnis. A professor arrives in London and investigates a devil worshipper.

programme.title: Nights of Cabiria
programme.desc: 1957. Drama. Director: Federico Fellini. Stars Giulietta, Francois Perier & Franca Marzi. A waifish prostitute only finds heartbreak while wandering the streets of Rome in search for love.

programme.title: Bob & Carol & Ted & Alice
programme.desc: 1969. Comedy Drama. Directed by Paul Mazursky. Stars Natalie Wood, Elliott Gould, Robert Culp & Dyan Cannon. Two couples find liberation in the Sexual Revolution of the 1960s.

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: Mechanical Watchman. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, John Howlett & Peter Allenby. Maguire catches a fur coat thief in the act; however, the other members of the gang remain unknown.

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: The Bold Whip. Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray run a stagecoach line in the Old West, where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: A Riddle a Day Keeps the Riddler Away. 1966. Stars Adam West, Frank Gorshin & Susan Silo. Batman and Robin try to outsmart the Riddler in a wicked plot to take over the city by kidnapping a king.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: When the Rat's Away, the Mice Will Play. 1966. Stars Adam West, Neil Hamilton & Frank Gorshin. Riddler sends word to Commissioner Gordon about a time bomb, and he calls upon Bruce Wayne for help.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Case of the Reluctant Carpenter. 1954. Starring: Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Archie Duncan. Sherlock is against the clock to locate a bomb hidden in London by an extortionist.

programme.title: Love from a Stranger
programme.desc: 1937. Drama. Stars Ann Harding, Basil Rathbone & Binnie Hale. A lottery winner breaks up with her fiancé and marries a fortune hunter who proves to be dangerous.

programme.title: The Snows of Kilimanjaro
programme.desc: 1952. Romance. Directed by Henry King & Roy Ward Baker. Stars Gregory Peck & Susan Hayward. A writer reflects on his life as he lies dying from an infection while on safari near Mount Kilimanjaro.

programme.title: Fools Rush In
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Director: Victor H. Komow. Stars Frank Silvera, Ken Buckridge & Jean Alexander. A ship with a cargo full of diamonds gets taken over by pirates.

programme.title: Screenagers! - Glimpses
programme.desc: Early 1960s documentary into the spending habit of 'screenagers' and the cinema goers of the 60s. Brilliant footage of 50s and 60s cinemas and the 'screenagers' themselves.

programme.title: Up In The World
programme.desc: 1956. Comedy. Director: John Paddy Carstairs. Stars Norman Wisdom, Maureen Swanson & Jerry Desmonde. A window cleaner works at a country estate where the owner's son is threatened by kidnappers.

programme.title: The Duchess of Duke Street
programme.desc: The Outsiders. 1976. Stars Gemma Jones, Christopher Cazenove & Derek Smith. A modest and kind man is treated like a visiting dignitary when Louisa and Charlie find out the reason for his visit.

programme.title: The Thirty Nine Steps (1978)
programme.desc: 1978. Crime. Director: Don Sharp. Stars Robert Powell, Karen Dotrice, David Warner & John Mills. An engineer attempts to prevent Prussian agents from executing a political assassination.

programme.title: Julius Hagen Season
programme.desc: Noel is back to explore another film from the producer Julius Hagen and introduces a piece of entertainment history with the 1934 film Music Hall.

programme.title: Music Hall
programme.desc: 1934. Musical. Director: John Baxter. Stars George Carney, Ben Field, Mark Daly & Helena Pickard. A rare film put out by Twickenham Film Studios which includes many original music hall acts.

programme.title: Julius Hagen Season
programme.desc: Tune in to find out which brilliant Julius Hagen film will be shown next week.

programme.title: Strange But True?
programme.desc: The Galway Poltergeist. 1997. Michael Aspel explores a family who claim they have all been terrorised by the same poltergeist and try to rid them of the spirit so they can live in peace.

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: Hit and Miss. 1974. Stars Richard Easton, Gabrielle Drake & Carleton Hobbs. The procedure for making Hammonds a public company gets underway. Meanwhile, Jill decides to throw a party.

programme.title: Mark Saber
programme.desc: The Law and the Lawless. 1957. Stars Donald Gray, Sandra Dorne & Amy Dalby. Actress Jean White moves to London, but when her mother stops receiving letters she calls on Mark Saber to investigate.

programme.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
programme.desc: Episode 21. 1975. Kenny Ball sings 'So Do I', Cool Breeze perform 'Reach Out Your Hand', Howard Keel performs 'No Business Like Showbusiness' and 'Oh What A Beautiful Morning'.

programme.title: Forever Amber
programme.desc: 1947. Drama. Directed by Otto Preminger & John M. Stahl. Stars Linda Darnell & Cornel Wilde. A woman confined by her Puritan upbringing, ventures to London where she finds a better life.

programme.title: H.M.S Defiant
programme.desc: 1962. Drama. Director: Lewis Gilbert. Stars Alec Guinness, Dirk Bogarde & Maurice Denham. During the French Revolutionary War, Captain Crawford is stuck in a battle of with his second in command.

programme.title: The Great Rupert
programme.desc: 1950. Family Comedy. Directed by Irving Pichel. Stars Jimmy Durante, Terry Moore & Tom Drake. A little dancing squirrel with lots of charm helps two families overcome their obstacles.

programme.title: Burke's Law
programme.desc: Who Killed the Swinger on a Hook? 1964. Stars Gene Barry, Gary Conway & Regis Toomey. Amos is on a list of six names at the same time a developer is found dead.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Thirteenth Hat. 1966. Stars Adam West, David Wayne & Sandra Wells. The Mad Hatter has a double plot to un-cowl Batman and to kidnap each member of the jury that once convicted him.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Batman Stands Pat. 1966. Stars Adam West, David Wayne & Madge Blake. Batman's escape from his plaster case allows him to continue his hunt for the Mad Hatter, who is after the twelfth juror.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Case of the Christmas Pudding. 1954. Starring: Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Eugene Deckers. A serial killer sentenced to death threatens to kill Sherlock before the execution.

programme.title: The Great Flamarion
programme.desc: 1945. Drama. Directed by Anthony Mann. Stars Erich von Stroheim, Mary Beth Hughes & Dan Duryea. A beautiful female performer manipulates all the men in her life in order to achieve her ambitions.

programme.title: Miracle on 34th Street
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Director: William Corrigan. Stars Ed Wynn, Peter Lind Hayes & Mary Healy. A kindly old gentleman claims to be the real Santa Claus and has to defend his sanity in court.

programme.title: Railway Murders
programme.desc: The First Railway Murderer. 2021. Stars Nicholas Day, Matthew Green & Alan Moss. The first ever murder on a British train. 70 year old victim Thomas Briggs was murdered in 1864 by Franz Muller.

programme.title: Do You Know This Voice?
programme.desc: 1964. Drama. Directed by Frank Nesbitt. Stars Dan Duryea, Isa Miranda, Gwen Watford & Peter Madden. In this great murder mystery, the only clue to the killer's identity is his shoes!

programme.title: Mrs. Pym of Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1939. Detective Drama. Directed by Fred Elles. Starring Mary Clare, Edward Lexy & Nigel Patrick. A woman detective sets about solving the murder of people who have all frequented the same medium.

programme.title: The Edgar Wallace Mystery Theatre
programme.desc: Dead Man's Chest. 1965. Directed by Patrick Dromgoole. Stars John Thaw, Ann Firbank & John Meillon. Things go disastrously wrong when two young journalists try to fake a murder.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Secret Mission. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Archie Duncan. The Sheriff of Nottingham offers to pardon Robin if he pledges allegiance to King John.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: 1959. Horror. Directed by Terence Fisher. Stars Peter Cushing, Christopher Lee & Yvonne Furneaux. A mummified priest is awakened by the opening of an Egyptian princess's sarcophagus.

programme.title: The Cheaters
programme.desc: The Hands of Adrian. 1962. Stars John Ireland, Robert Ayres & Delphi Lawrence. A violinist is playing in the village and Eastern have insured him. Walter Allan is convinced it is a scam.

programme.title: A Family At War
programme.desc: 1971. Giving And Taking. Created by John Finch. Stars Colin Douglas & Shelagh Fraser. Edwin and Jean go to the cottage of their recently deceased father. Jenny pays the Briggs a visit. (S2, E12)

programme.title: Look At Life Through Glass
programme.desc: 1960. A look at the interesting profession of window cleaning and the various problems they may face.

programme.title: Chase a Crooked Shadow
programme.desc: 1958. Thriller. Director: Michael Anderson. Stars Anne Baxter, Richard Todd & Herbert Lom. At Kimberley's villa, a stranger shows-up & claims he is her brother who she thought to be dead.

programme.title: Public Eye
programme.desc: 1973. Detective & Mystery Drama. Egg & Cress Sandwiches. Stars Alfred Burke, Robert Flemyng, Ray Smith & Brian Blessed. An unconventional vicar brings trouble to Marker.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: On this dark night join Caroline Munro in The Cellar Club as she introduces the Watchers, a science fiction horror from 1988 based on a novel by Dean Koontz.

programme.title: Watchers
programme.desc: 1988. Sci-fi Horror. Directed by Jon Hess. Stars Corey Haim, Michael Ironside, Blu Mankuma. A young boy adopts a stray dog unaware it's being hunted by a dangerous creature and a government agent.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: That is all from the Cellar Club tonight and Caroline Munro is here to bring the night to a close.

programme.title: The Executioner
programme.desc: 1970. Thriller. Directed by Sam Wanamaker. Stars George Peppard, Joan Collins & Judy Geeson. A British agent is determined to prove that a respected colleague is really a Soviet spy.

programme.title: Meet John Doe
programme.desc: 1941. Drama. Directed by Frank Capra. Stars Gary Cooper, Barbara Stanwyck & Edward Arnold. A drifter finds himself at the centre of a political movement after becoming part of a fraudulent story.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1956. The Case of the River Morgue. Directed by Montgomery Tully. Starring Hugh Moxey, Gordon Needham and Jane Welsh. The police are summoned when a dead body is stolen. (S1, E16)

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Week-End Guest. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Mary Hinton & Kenneth Haigh. A young reporter is sent by a London newspaper to interview a woman regarding a celebrated author.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Joker Goes to School. 1966. Stars Adam West, Cesar Romero & Kip King. Batman and Robin attempt to put a stop to the Joker's plot to recruit high school dropouts into his gang.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: He Meets His Match, the Grisly Ghoul. 1966. Stars Adam West, Cesar Romero & Neil Hamilton. Robin agrees to infiltrate the Bad Pennies in a dangerous undercover mission.

programme.title: Target Earth
programme.desc: 1954. Sci-Fi. Directed by Sherman A. Rose. Starring Richard Denning. A large city is ordered to be completely evacuated as an army of robots, believed to be from the planet Venus, attack it.

programme.title: The Dragon of Pendragon Castle
programme.desc: 1950. Family. Directed by John Baxter. Stars Leslie Bradley, David Hannaford & J. Hubert Leslie. An old man lives with his two grandchildren in a cold, drafty castle where they discover a dragon.

programme.title: Runaround
programme.desc: 1981. Presented by Mike Reid. Features Barry Sheene. Prizes include a digital watch & a pocket computer. This episode was recorded on Charles & Diana's wedding day and features grand prix motorbikes.

programme.title: Legend of the Hidden City
programme.desc: 1997. Stars Brendan Pollecutt, Fezile Mpela & Robert Finlayson. Kabeth and Ammon get help to get hold of the scrolls; Morgan prepares his men to break into the prison and Ram captures Dean.

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Young Widow. 1959. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. Having escaped from Gessler's troops, Tell and his wife are given refuge by the beautiful Countess von Marheim.

programme.title: Hawkeye & the Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Winter Passage. 1957. Directed by Sam Newfield. Stars John Hart, Lon Chaney Jr.& Kay Hawtrey. Frontier wives hope to join their husbands in time for Christmas.

programme.title: The Lone Ranger
programme.desc: Lone Ranger Triumphs. 1949. Stars Jay Silverheels, Clayton Moore & John Hart. The Lone Ranger still on the trail of Butch Cavendish and his gang sends Tonto to the town of Colby.

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: Flight of Fancy. 1961. Stars David Graham & Graydon Gould. Jimmy falls asleep reading about the missing princess of Barania. He wakes and steals Supercar to launch a dangerous rescue operation.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Borrowed Baby. 1957. Stars Richard Greene, Bernadette O'Farrell & Sylvia Kay. The Sheriff plots to arrest Maid Marian for assisting Robin and the outlaws, using a borrowed baby as bait.

programme.title: Attack from Space
programme.desc: 1965. Sci-fi. Directed by Koreyoshi Akasaka, Teruo Ishii & Akira Mitsuwa. Stars Ken Utsui & Sachihiro Ohsawa. The rulers of planet Emerald send superhero Starman to protect Earth from evil aliens.

programme.title: I'm All Right Jack
programme.desc: 1959. Comedy. Director: John Boulting. Stars Peter Sellers, Terry-Thomas & Ian Carmichael. After leaving the army, upper class Windrush takes a job in industry. He then accidently starts a strike.

programme.title: Scales of Justice
programme.desc: 1963. Undesirable Neighbour. Stars Vanda Godsell & Bridget Armstrong. Based on a real case, a newly married woman becomes very friendly with her male neighbours. (S1, E05)

programme.title: This Happy Breed
programme.desc: 1944. Drama. Director: David Lean. Stars Robert Newton, Celia Johnson, John Mills & Stanley Holloway. After WW1, a family lead an ordinary sort of life until the outbreak of WW2.

programme.title: Dick Turpin
programme.desc: Sentence of Death: Part 1. 1982. Stars Richard O'Sullivan & Alfie Bass. After spending years imprisoned in Jamaica, Barnaby Husk seeks revenge. Isaac Rag takes King George's cousin under his wing.

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: Inspector Lognon's Triumph. 1961. Stars Rupert Davies, Neville Jason & Henry Oscar. Maigret works on a case with his old rival, the constantly miserable Inspector Lognon.

programme.title: Lillie
programme.desc: Emilie. 1978. Stars Francesca Annis, Anton Rodgers, Patrick Holt. On Jersey, young Emelie Charlotte Le Breton grows up as one of the boys, but her mother takes her to London to show her a Season.

programme.title: Our Man Flint
programme.desc: 1966. Comedy. Directed by Daniel Mann. Stars James Coburn, Lee Cobb & Gila Golan. Top agent Derek Flint is called in to investigate why the world is being affected by extreme, violent weather.

programme.title: EuroTrash
programme.desc: 1998. Hosted by Antoine de Caunes. Tonight, Lolo shows us her bicycle pumps, there's a backstage look at the reigning queen of finish fitness and take an onstage dive with some naked Austrians.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Raves
programme.desc: 2001. Stars Vernon Kay, Paul Eastwood & Glenn Ward. Following a group of young people around America as they go to various raves, nightclubs, events and other parties.

Alan sets his team the challenge of transforming the Woods' garden into a coastal haven, inspired by Alex's passion for surfing and the home's proximity to the sea. David Domoney upcycles a boat to create a bespoke daybed, Katie Rushworth turns old fruit barrels into raised planters and Frances Tophill introduces swathes of hardy flowers mixed in with paths of shingle

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Chris Hull and Charlie Dimmock redesign a garden for an art-loving family in Harpenden. Claire and James's outdoor plot contains an art studio at the back, which Chris's design incorporates, while Charlie turns this area into an art-inspired gravel zone. Which option will the couple go for?

programme.title: Case Sensitive
programme.desc: Part one of two. New DS Charlie Zailer finds herself working with DC Simon Waterhouse for the first time when Geraldine Bretherick and her five-year-old daughter Lucy are found dead in the bathroom of their luxury home, and the two argue about whether the case is one of murder, suicide or something more sinister. Meanwhile, a woman tells her best friend she had an affair with Bretherick's husband and wants to see him again. Thriller, based on the novel Point of Rescue by Sophie Hannah, starring Olivia Williams, Darren Boyd, Rupert Graves and Amy Beth Hayes

programme.title: Build a New Life in the Country
programme.desc: 9/9. The Kennedy family are renovating a listed 500-year-old building on the banks of a river. It needs an overhaul and archaeological dig - a true labour of love. Last in series.

programme.title: Edwardian Farm
programme.desc: Alex Langlands and Peter Ginn plough the land to plant potatoes and oats in an effort to secure some income, and are introduced to one of the Edwardian age's prime agricultural innovations - the tractor. Elsewhere, Ruth Goodman prepares for the arrival of the pigs by restoring an ingenious compost-maker, Peter starts to build a trout farm, and Alex learns to forge a billhook to maintain the hedgerows

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Stories
programme.desc: Rick is in Leicester, where food writer Gurdeep Loyal gives him a tour of the city's best Indian food, from a hidden gem food truck to Indian high tea. He also samples Michelin-starred fare from Birmingham chef Aktar Islam and hears the story of how a traditional mill was saved by the local demand for chapati flour. Back home Rick cooks the UK's favourite, chicken tikka masala
